desc: Rebuild the daily SD-root initramfs and boot object from the 3006-fixed scripts/t6040-sdroot-init and t6040-sdroot-shutdown, so ticket 216 can test a shutdown path that can actually complete. Object bdd8cc86 (216's pin) carries the pre-fix init block and shutdown program, which score 0/23 in scripts/t6040-test-sdroot-shutdown.sh; its init/inittab pins were already stale against HEAD. Deliver: harness PASS on the exact committed scripts, two byte-identical builds, t6040-image-preflight.sh PASS (Norwegian keymap at all layers), maxcpus=1, ANS/NVMe still disabled, then independent exact-artifact review and new 216 hashes for CJ. Coordinate with 301/4003: any daily SD-root object, trackpad-integrated or not, must carry the fixed scripts. Offline only: no card access, enrollment or rig lease.
author: claude
bootargs: maxcpus=1 idle=nop nokaslr pd_ignore_unused clk_ignore_unused fbcon=font:TER16x32 ignore_loglevel console=ttydc0 console=tty0 rdinit=/init
review_needed: Independent exact-artifact review (not claude): DT status gates, firmware manifest, embedded init/shutdown (= 3006 harness 23/23 set), strict verifier, preflight, console-order change. Then CJ re-pins 216.
